subject: MAP kickoff: Apex Clinical evaluation & close timeline
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@apexclinical.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Apr 2026 14:12:00 -0400
Subject: MAP kickoff: Apex Clinical evaluation & close timeline

Hi Ellen —

Great to meet you on the demo earlier. As discussed, I wanted to kick off a short mutual action plan (MAP) to align scope, owners, and a pragmatic timeline so we can get Apex Clinical to production-grade inference for clinical notes by the end of Q2.

High-level goals we heard:
- Production-quality text generation for structured clinical summaries (latency <= 250ms p50 for 512 tokens)
- Data isolation and HIPAA-friendly deployment (VPC + customer KMS)
- Cost target in line with your pilot budget (estimate to confirm after profiling)

Proposed next steps / timeline:
1) This week — confirm champion and technical owner, and agree on target evaluation dataset (by Fri, Apr 9)
2) Week of Apr 12 — MAP kickoff call (30 min): confirm success criteria, test data, and sandbox access
3) Apr 19–May 14 — evaluation run (profile latency, quality, and cost)
4) May 17–28 — rollout planning, security/compliance checklist and procurement

Can you confirm:
- Primary champion for the program (we think that's you)
- Technical owner who will own dataset access and sandbox infra
- Any black-out dates in April/May for the exec stakeholders

I attached a brief MAP template and the security questionnaire that procurement asked for earlier. I’ll follow up with a calendar invite for a 30-minute kickoff next week.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on this.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: map-template-apex-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), apex-security-questionnaire.pdf (pdf)
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@apexclinical.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: David Cho <david.cho@apexclinical.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Apr 2026 16:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: Apex Clinical evaluation & close timeline

Thanks Marcus —

Appreciate the write-up and the template. Confirming I’ll be the program champion for Apex Clinical. I’ll loop in David Cho (Engineering Manager) as the technical owner — he’ll handle dataset pulls and give us a sandbox contact.

Quick notes from my side:
- Success criteria: clinical summary F1 >= 0.82 on our annotated holdout, and median latency <= 300ms during office hours (we can be flexible on p99 SLAs during the pilot)
- Procurement will need the security questionnaire filled; I’ve CC’d procurement alias.
- Preferred kickoff window: Thu Apr 15 or Mon Apr 19 afternoons (ET)

I reviewed the MAP template briefly — I’ll add preliminary stakeholder names to the sheet by Thu. Can you confirm whether sandbox tokens will be short-lived or linked to our VPC when we start?

Best,
Ellen Park
VP Product, Apex Clinical
ellen.park@apexclinical.com

- I’ll propose two kickoff times (Thu Apr 15 3:00 PM ET and Mon Apr 19 2:00 PM ET) — will share a calendar invite once you confirm which works better.
